Short title and commencement

ACT XVI OF 1991
ACT XVI OF 1991
CRIMINAL LAW
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860
and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898]
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I 27th November, 1991]
The following Acts of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 25th November, 1991,
and are hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Criminal Law (Second
Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Section 295-A, Act XLV of 1860

ACT XVI OF 1991
ACT XVI OF 1991
CRIMINAL LAW
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860
and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898]
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I 27th November, 1991]
The following Acts of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 25th November, 1991,
and are hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of Section 295-A,
Act XLV of 1860:----In the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), in
section 295-A for the words "two years" the words "ten
years" shall be substituted.

Amendment of Schedule II, Act V of 1898

Act V of 1898:-----In the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898),

column 7, for the figure "2" the figure "10" shall be
substituted.
